paragraphs: We hereby declare that the micro-project report entitled 'Plant Watering Reminder using STM32 and Soil Moisture Sensor' submitted in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the award of the degree of Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering is an authentic record of our own work carried out under the supervision of the faculty guide.
The matter embodied in this report has not been submitted by us or any other person for the award of any other degree or diploma.
